subject: Post-signature MPA: Integration surge plan & evaluation cadence
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@averyhealth.com>; procurement@averyhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-signature MPA: Integration surge plan & evaluation cadence

Hi Samira / Avery team,

Thanks again for signing — excited to get moving. Attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MPA_v1.3.xlsx) and a short canary checklist (canary-checklist.pdf). Key items below so we keep alignment on owners and timing for the post-signature window.

High-level sprint plan (weeks are business weeks after signature):
- Week 1 (Jan 25–29): Integration prep & access (VPN, service accounts, test data provision). Owner: Avery IT / Laura (Redwood).
- Week 2 (Feb 1–5): Shadow integration & smoke tests against a subset of traffic; begin staff training workshop A. Owner: Redwood eng + Avery SRE.
- Week 3 (Feb 8–12): Canary window: route 10% of production traffic to Redwood dedicated instance for 48 hours with continuous monitoring. Canary rollback criteria defined in checklist. Owner: Ben (Redwood) / Avery Ops.
- Week 4 (Feb 15–19): Migration weekend (optional phased migration if canary passes) — planned 2am–6am ET maintenance window. Owner: Avery Ops.
- Week 5 (Feb 22–26): Full cutover verification, acceptance eval, and knowledge transfer (training-agenda.docx). Owner: Laura (Redwood).

Evaluation plan (embedded in MPA tab 'Evals'):
- Pre-canary baseline: collect token latency P50/P95, 7-day error rates, and sample output quality on 500 prompt set.
- Canary signal set: token latency, tail-latency traces, and automated quality checks (prompt set A/B). Automated alerts will gate rollback.
- Acceptance: incremental SLA target P95 <= 850ms for targeted workloads, quality regression <= 2% on eval prompts.

Open questions for you (quick):
1) Can your team provision the service account and test dataset by Jan 24 EOD?
2) Any blackout windows for Feb 15–19 migration? If so, share exact dates/times.
3) Preferred recipients for weekly MAP sync invite (we propose Tuesdays at 10am ET).

Next steps: I’ll schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff once we confirm access + blackout windows. If the high-level looks fine, we’ll lock MPA_v1.3 as the source of truth and track progress on the deal portal.

Attachments: MPA_v1.3.xlsx (MPA), canary-checklist.pdf (runbook)

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147
https://redwood.ai
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@averyhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@averyhealth.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-signature MPA: Integration surge plan & evaluation cadence

Thanks Stephanie — this looks thorough, and the timeline aligns with our internal goals. A few clarifications before we lock the schedule: 

- Service accounts: we can provision the test service account by Jan 24 but need the exact scope/roles. Can you send the minimal IAM permissions?
- Blackout windows: Feb 17 (all day) is a hard blackout for one of our downstream reporting jobs. Can we avoid any planned migration activity that day?
- Migration weekend: our team prefers the migration window on Feb 18–19 02:00–06:00 ET instead of Feb 15–19. That narrows the risk window.

Also want to confirm rollback SLA: if canary triggers a rollback, do you have a runbook we can review that outlines expected RTO and who invokes rollback?

If you can send IAM permissions + a short rollback summary, I’ll take those to procurement for final sign-off.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Platform Integrations | Avery Health
samira.khan@averyhealth.com

Quick internal note following Samira's questions — drafting concrete items we should send Samira this week: 

1) Minimal IAM permissions (I created a short bullet list below):
   - Read/write on test bucket (s3://avery-test-data) for service account
   - Inference invocation role with policy limited to /v1/infer endpoints
   - Log write to their dev project for traces (so we can stream logs into our monitoring)
2) Canary rollback summary (3 bullets for a customer-friendly doc we will attach):
   - Who invokes rollback: Avery Ops primary, Redwood eng second; both must confirm via Slack + Doc (2 approvals)
   - RTO: expected state restore < 30 minutes for traffic split changes; full refreeze < 2 hours if fallback needed
   - Post-rollback analysis: 24-hour postmort with joint RCA and prioritized remediation backlog
3) Proposed migration window update (respect Samira's blackout on Feb 17): suggest migration on Feb 18 02:00–06:00 ET; include a dry-run on Feb 16 02:00–04:00 ET to validate scripts.

I'll prepare the two short artifacts (IAM bullet list + rollback one-pager) and attach training-agenda.docx. Laura — can you own the dry-run checklist and the acceptance test harness?

—
